name: Alchemist Corporation Limited
about: Alchemist Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a software development and technology solutions company in India and internationally. It also develops and operates e-commerce platforms, online marketplaces, digital payment solutions, fintech solutions, and mobile wallet integrations; undertakes advertising, marketing and digital promotion activities; and provides consultancy and professional services in the fields of IT, digital transformation, AI, cybersecurity, blockchain, and related technologies. Alchemist Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Gurugram, India. Alchemist Corporation Limited operates as a subsidiary of Wallet Circle Technologies Private Limited.
